subject: reasoning
question: Pointing to a woman, Raj said, "She is the daughter-in-law of the grandmother of my father's only son." How is the woman related to Raj?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: 

Raj's father's only son → **Raj himself**.

Grandmother of Raj → **Raj's paternal grandmother**.

Daughter-in-law of Raj's grandmother → **wife of Raj's father**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/958a1efde46987a1dce32ebaaf60a71cd5f9b9d591ef04df9c6918d8b39c5d76.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f32268a6289fc3b793e5f76bbeb4a358335307e222490744fcf364a1eff53948.png] 

So, the woman is **Raj's mother**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
